description: This file provides configuration helper functions for authentication, including tenant salt configuration, tenant resolution, and JWT settings, and exports these functions for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: getTenantSaltConfig
methods.description: Returns flags about static salt configuration without exposing the value.

methods.name: getTenantConfig
methods.description: Provides strategy to resolve and allow tenants based on request headers, organization ID, or default.

methods.name: getJwtConfig
methods.description: Provides JWT configuration parameters from environment variables.
